C1820.title: UT Austin Humphreys Team Drone GPS Spoofing Hijack Demonstration
C1820.summary: In June 2012, the UT Austin aerospace engineering team of Todd Humphreys, invited by DHS, demonstrated the first successful GPS-spoofing hijack of a UAV at White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico. The team used ~$1000 of self-made GPS-spoofing equipment to take over a hovering small civilian drone from about 1 km away, deflecting its heading while the autopilot remained unaware. The demo revealed the fundamental weakness of unencrypted, unauthenticated civilian GPS signals, prompting FAA and Congress to reassess drone airspace-integration security.
